rules: Low Perception; high patron skill; high Int; low AC; low Fortitude; low HP; low accuracy; high to extreme spell DC. Abilities: prepared spellcasting of a tradition based on patron as a witch of their level, familiar, witch's patron and related cantrip, hex, and spells

notes.defense: Low AC; low Fortitude; low HP.
notes.spells: High to extreme spell DC. Prepared spellcasting of its patron's tradition as a witch of its level: {maxrank}. Patron cantrip, hexes and spells.
notes.specials: Familiar, witch's patron and related feats.
